about: What this OverPass Wine build supports. Installed as share/overpass/features.json; component manifests list the features they need. A feature's version goes up when its behaviour or switches change incompatibly.

dll-path-prepend.summary: Directories searched before Wine's own DLLs, so a bottle can use other DLLs without changing the Wine install

compat-rules.summary: Per-program INI rules: arguments, environment, DLL overrides, graphics backend, replacement program

d3d9-backend-rule.summary: Compatibility rule key d3d9 = mtld3d | wined3d

rosetta-code-regions.summary: Native PE code regions registered with Rosetta without Apple's libraries

no-mac-frame.summary: Windows without a Mac title bar, for programs that draw their own frame

max-resolution.summary: Display modes up to desktop, display or a given size

services-elevated.summary: Services run with an administrator token

game-mode-bundle.summary: Each program runs from a small app bundle that macOS treats as a game (Game Mode)

x87sidecar.summary: 32-bit programs can run under x87sidecar's x87 translation

gstreamer.summary: Media Foundation and DirectShow video and audio through bundled GStreamer

dll-file-map.summary: The main executable can be loaded from an inherited file descriptor

winhttp-http2.summary: WinHTTP speaks HTTP/2 (negotiated with ALPN), decompresses responses and reports the server certificate chain

gdk-winrt.summary: WinRT and Win32 pieces GDK games call: text input services, app state registration, data transfer, device enumeration, GetIntegratedDisplaySize, WinHTTP GDK options
